feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 October 2026 4:04pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 21 October 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Frontal system will clear away from the Irish Sea this evening, very weak ridge of high pressure follows later tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 6 to gale 8, gradually decreasing 5 or 6 this evening, 4 occasionally 5 overnight, then West or Southwest 3 or 4 later tomorrow morning and afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate this evening, then slight later tonight or tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Rain at first, but clearing to isolated showers this evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, backing East 5 or 6 early tomorrow night, then North or Northwest 5 to 7 by dawn Friday. Increasing Northwest 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8 on Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Fair, then heavy rain for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
